action_proposals.description: Perform two perpendicular squeezes on the playdoh. First, move to the center, descend, squeeze to 4cm width, release, rotate 90 degrees, and squeeze again to 4cm.

action_sequence.reasoning: Move the gripper from its initial position to be directly centered above the blue playdoh.
Lower the gripper to the specified height of 0.257m, just above the table, to prepare for squeezing.
Squeeze the playdoh along its current axis to a width of 4cm to begin shaping it.
Open the gripper to release the playdoh after the first squeeze.
Rotate the gripper 90 degrees (pi/2 radians) to prepare for squeezing from a perpendicular direction.
Perform a second squeeze on the playdoh from a perpendicular angle to a width of 4cm to form a block shape.
Open the gripper to release the final shaped playdoh.
